description_en: Stops an IPC device from pushing streams
description_zh: 调用该接口停止IPC设备推流
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual stop-live-streaming --iot-id C47T6xwp6ms4bNlkHRWCg40000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name camera1 --stream-type 0 --iot-instance-id iot-cn-n6w1y590000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopLiveStreaming

parameters.description_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by the IoT platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call the [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) operation of the IoT platform to query the device ID.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** on a one-to-one basis. If you specify **IotId** together with **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>

><notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>

parameters.description_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the **Products** page of the IoT platform console, or call the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation to view the information about all products under the current account.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

- **1**: sub stream.

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If <props="intl"><ph>the **Instance Overview** page or</ph></props> no ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance overview](~~356505~~).
